profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc., which also goes by Digital Realty, is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, and listed under the ticker DLR. Its website describes it as a provider of data center services and colocation, offering interconnection capabilities across a global ecosystem that includes data centers, connectivity and cloud services. The company says it operates what it calls the world's largest data center platform, serving deployments from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows.

On AI, the site frames infrastructure as the pressure point, saying inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits and that AI is evolving faster than infrastructure can lag behind. It points to a 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, reporting that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint and describing a shift among enterprises from AI strategy to execution.

The company's SEC registration is recorded under CIK 0001297996. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it, and no specific products are tracked.
